step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram displays a serverless analytics architecture at HealthFirst. Data sources ingest data into an operational database. AWS CloudFormation orchestrates processing flows in three tiers: Analysis (Redshift, S3 Analysis bucket, Redshift, and End User), Core Strategic (Step Functions, S3 Core bucket, and Glue), and Insights (Lambda, S3 Insights bucket, and SageMaker). SQS handles operational exception handling.
